$comment: ADR-2153 launch contract: how each seed tool is started. {slug}, {model} and {wrapper} are substituted per seed. model_argv is appended only when the seed names a model; model_env is how a tool that has no model flag receives one. blockers are pane texts that mean the session is waiting on a human; ready, where present, is pane text that means the agent can take a prompt. Verified by tests/cli/session-launch-contract.test.mjs against the pinned CLI versions.

wrapper.$comment: A seed whose slug has config/harness-wrappers/<slug>.sh (openrouter, zai, router). The wrapper owns env, profile and model.

blockers: You are currently not signed in

opencode.$comment: OpenCode v2 removed the TUI model flag (2.0.32: -m and --model are 'Unrecognized flag'). The model rides OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT; --standalone keeps each session off the shared background service so per-session models cannot collide.
